description: Rames de métro utilisées sur le réseau STAR is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by STAR. Liste des rames de métro utilisées pour réaliser le transport des voyageurs du réseau STAR, comprenant notamment leur marque, leur modèle et leur kilométrage. A l'heure actuelle, le réseau STAR ne comptant qu'une seule ligne, la précision des lignes sur lesquelles les rames peuvent rouler n'est pas indiquée. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. The portal shows 62 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2014-11-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
